detailed_descriptions.en: All the toy series have been mixed together, and you need to sort and reorganize them. From cute, heartwarming plush animals to cool, stunning supercars; from vividly characterized action figures to solidly built mecha models—all these toys are now jumbled up, and you must reclassify and put them away. Break the rules. Redefine organizing. I know you've played plenty of tidy up/organizing games before. This time, however, it's different: you'll have no time pressure, no goal‑oriented stress—just pure, play free, however you like. You can arrange any toy in any way you please, break free from all constraints, boldly unleash your creativity, and let your personality shine here.
